title: Do I contradict myself? Very well then, I contradict myself.
html_source: Direct quotation from Walt Whitman’s “Song of Myself” from Leaves of Grass: “Do I contradict myself? Very well then … . I contradict myself; I am large … . I contain multitudes.”
